items.title: Stranger Things
items.synopsis: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and one strange little girl.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.synopsis: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
episodes.synopsis: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
episodes.synopsis: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.synopsis: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

episodes.synopsis: Frantic to find where Min-ji is, Manager Kim uses his skills from his days as Agent Kim — a secret agent who specialized in ruthless enemy takedowns.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim reconnects with Sung Han-soo and Park Jin-cheol — his fellow dad friends (and former secret agents) — on his search for Min-ji.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim's risky actions put him on the radar of enemies past and present. When danger strikes, Han-soo and Jin-cheol step up to help save the day.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim trades blows with the enemy agent chasing him — only to realize he is an old friend. Meanwhile, Min-ji attempts an escape of her own.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Min-ji finds herself in a dire situation — until special agent Jung Sang-a shows up. The Special Missions Directorate tries to lure out Manager Kim.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim and Min-ji finally reunite, but the path to safety is far from smooth. Later, Manager Kim is forced to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim is captured and tortured — until the Special Missions Directorate steps in with a final mission. Ju Gang-chan makes a plan to get revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.synopsis: With Manager Kim's mission a failure, the three agent dads team up with Sang-a to fight their way out — but Gang-chan has another trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.synopsis: Pushed to the brink by Gang-chan, Manager Kim must now make a crucial choice with Han-soo and Jin-cheol. Will Manager Kim be able to keep Min-ji safe?

episodes.title: Course Nº 1 Gochujang Butter Bibimbap
episodes.synopsis: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

episodes.title: Course N° 2 Sous Vide Cuisine
episodes.synopsis: Held captive in harsh conditions, Ji-young prepares a feast to win her freedom — but even her talent can't save her when a crisis puts her life in peril.

episodes.title: Course N° 3 Haute Cuisine
episodes.synopsis: Ji-young becomes Yi Heon's new chief royal cook after impressing him with her French cuisine. But Kang Mok-ju, consumed by jealousy, plots against her.

episodes.title: Course N° 4 **** and Spinach Doenjang Soup
episodes.synopsis: A high-stakes royal cooking competition awaits Ji-young and her fate at court hangs in the balance. Later, a troubled Yi Heon drunkenly summons her.

episodes.title: Course N° 5 Snowflake Schnitzel
episodes.synopsis: After an intimate moment together, Yi Heon begins rejecting Ji-young's meals — but soon find their minds wandering toward each other amid the distance.

episodes.title: Course N° 6 Black Sesame Macaron
episodes.synopsis: When the Ming envoy demands a cooking contest, Ji-young rises to the challenge to represent Joseon — and win what Yi Heon has promised her.

episodes.title: Course N° 7 Dongnae Pajeon on a Rainy Day
episodes.synopsis: In order to gain an edge in the cooking competition, Ji-young sets out to create a unique pot. However, finding the right craftsman proves difficult.

episodes.title: Course N° 8 Rice Wine Beef Bourguignon
episodes.synopsis: Barely making it to the competition, Ji-young begins cooking — only to find her crucial ingredients missing. Can she overcome the crisis?

episodes.title: Course N° 9 Pressure-Cooked Ogyetang
episodes.synopsis: Yi Heon shocks everyone by asking chefs to judge their own dishes. As time slips away in the intense battle, Ji-young considers plan B for her recipe.

episodes.title: Course N° 10 Joseon Restaurant
episodes.synopsis: Yi Heon and Ji-young's bond deepens as he fights to prove her innocence — but can they uncover the cause of Grand Prince Jinmyeong's illness in time?

items.title: Formula 1: Drive to Survive

episodes.synopsis: As a new season begins under the lights of London's O2 Arena, six rookies join the grid and a seven-time World Champion hangs his helmet in a new garage.

episodes.title: The Duel
episodes.synopsis: Mercedes and Ferrari fight for second in the Constructors' title as rookie Kimi Antonelli and legend Lewis Hamilton shoulder expectations in new teams.

episodes.title: What Happens In Vegas
episodes.synopsis: Vegas delivers glitz, risk and a new team principal working the pit wall. With the stakes higher than ever, McLaren are willing to take a gamble.

episodes.title: Call Me Chucky
episodes.synopsis: After a Vegas setback, McLaren reach Abu Dhabi with their lead under threat from the reigning World Champion. When the flag falls, who holds their nerve?

episodes.title: Part One The Prophet
episodes.synopsis: Forced to leave behind his life as a prince in Egypt, Moses finds refuge in Midian. A mysterious encounter compels him to take on a divine mission.

episodes.title: Part Two The Plagues
episodes.synopsis: Moses confronts the pharaoh and demands the Hebrews be freed. But when the pharaoh refuses, a series of plagues are unleashed on Egypt.

episodes.title: Part Three The Promised Land
episodes.synopsis: The pharaoh relents after the 10th plague only to change his mind. An obstacle turns into a miracle at the Red Sea as Moses leads the Hebrews to freedom.

episodes.title: Empire
episodes.synopsis: After a bitter freeze, the Cretaceous era ushers in high sea levels that find pterosaurs flying to islands to feast and dinosaurs hunting in the oceans.

episodes.title: Fall
episodes.synopsis: Dinosaurs rule the entire planet, with T. rex as the most deadly. But as the continents split and drift, danger lurks far away in the depths of space.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Radio fragments offer key evidence to identify the bomb maker. Scottish detective Ed McCusker heads to Washington D.C. to strengthen intelligence sharing.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: A breakthrough from the luggage list sends Scottish detectives to Malta. Mounting pressure and a promising prospect test Special Agent Dick Marquise.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: 1990. As investigators discover similarities between Pan Am and another bombing, a key piece of evidence exposes a costly oversight by Dick and the FBI.

episodes.title: Episode 6
